author: Luna_pyon
body:
Hi. I'm here to appeal my infraction because I'm ready to change.I just want to say that I was warned to watch my language when I said " holy fucl". First of all, fucl isn't a swear word. In fact, I deliberately censored it in order not to swear as, although it may not seem like it at times, I care about not getting infractions-especially due to recent events. Secondly, I had no verbal warning. Now, I know that verbal warns and /warn are interchangeable but hear me out, please. Using /warn instead of verballing seems very infraction thirsty. In some contexts, skipping a verbal could be useful, however, in a context such as this using /warn is unfair, infraction hungry and pointless. A verbal in this instance is all that's necessary. One line. Two words. Censored. It's hardly punishment-worth. Now, you may say the usual: "Its only a warn, get over it" well, I'm truly sorry, but I disagree with that statement here. With the amount of infractions I have, this one pointless punishment has affected me massively. Another occurance was the “abusing glitch” infraction dealt by 99.I didn’t get complains or anything from the players I killed so I didn’t know that i was invisible. If i knew I was invisible I would obviously relog. But instead of getting a verbal from 99 I get a kick. A simple verbal would’ve made me relog but a kick was not neccesarry 
I also promise to:
    -Watch my language
    -never be toxic
    -be more nice
    -no more swearing
    -not complain

Finally, I would like to say that I am very sorry for being annoying to pretty much everyone whenever I get pissed. I was such an immature person, I get pissed easily and I am very sorry for all of my bad actions.
